# 00000000568

**English.** Definition: The cluster algebra of a surface is generated by flips of arcs, and its number of cluster variables is the total of arcs plus punctured arcs. Conjecture: On a surface of genus g with m marked points, this count has the closed form N(g,m) = Σ_k (2k+1)·C_k(g,m), where C_k(g,m) are Poincare-polynomial coefficients; in particular N(g,1) = 6g−3+Σ_i 2^i·C(2g,i).

**中文。** 定义：曲面的 cluster 代数由弧的翻转生成,其簇变量数为弧数与带切口弧数之和。猜想：亏格 g、带标记点 m 的曲面上,该计数有闭式 N(g,m)=Σ_k (2k+1)·C_k(g,m),其中 C_k(g,m) 为 Poincaré 多项式系数;特别地 N(g,1)=6g−3+Σ_{i}2^i·C(2g,i)。
